items.name: Circle
items.fact: A circle has no corners or edges and is perfectly round in every direction

items.name: Square
items.fact: A square has four equal sides and four right angles of exactly 90 degrees

items.name: Triangle
items.fact: A triangle has three sides and the angles inside always add up to 180 degrees

items.name: Rectangle
items.fact: A rectangle has four right angles but opposite sides are equal not all four

items.name: Pentagon
items.fact: A pentagon has five sides and five corners and is the shape of a home base in baseball

items.name: Hexagon
items.fact: A hexagon has six sides and honeybees build perfect hexagons in their hives

items.name: Heptagon
items.fact: A heptagon has seven sides and some coins like the British 50p use this shape

items.name: Octagon
items.fact: An octagon has eight sides and is the shape of a stop sign

items.name: Nonagon
items.fact: A nonagon has nine sides and nine angles inside

items.name: Decagon
items.fact: A decagon has ten equal sides and ten angles

items.name: Oval
items.fact: An oval is like a stretched circle and is also called an ellipse

items.name: Diamond
items.fact: A diamond shape is a square turned 45 degrees on its corner

items.name: Star
items.fact: A five-pointed star is called a pentagram and has been used in flags worldwide

items.name: Heart
items.fact: The heart shape is a universal symbol of love used in all cultures

items.name: Crescent
items.fact: A crescent is the shape of the Moon when it is partly lit by the Sun

items.name: Trapezoid
items.fact: A trapezoid has one pair of parallel sides and is like a triangle with the top cut off

items.name: Parallelogram
items.fact: A parallelogram has two pairs of parallel sides that lean to one side

items.name: Rhombus
items.fact: A rhombus has four equal sides like a square but the angles are not 90 degrees

items.name: Sphere
items.fact: A sphere is a perfectly round 3D ball where every point on the surface is equidistant

items.name: Cube
items.fact: A cube has six square faces twelve edges and eight corners all equal

items.name: Cylinder
items.fact: A cylinder is like a can with two circular ends and one curved surface

items.name: Cone
items.fact: A cone has a circular base that narrows to a sharp point at the top

items.name: Pyramid
items.fact: A pyramid has a square base and four triangular faces meeting at a point

items.name: Torus
items.fact: A torus is the mathematical name for a donut shape with a hole in the middle

items.name: Tetrahedron
items.fact: A tetrahedron has four triangular faces and is the simplest 3D solid shape

items.name: Octahedron
items.fact: An octahedron has eight triangular faces and looks like two pyramids stuck together

items.name: Dodecahedron
items.fact: A dodecahedron has twelve pentagonal faces and is one of the five Platonic solids

items.name: Icosahedron
items.fact: An icosahedron has twenty triangular faces and looks like a fancy soccer ball

items.name: Prism
items.fact: A prism has two identical parallel faces connected by rectangular sides

items.name: Ellipsoid
items.fact: An ellipsoid is like a stretched sphere such as the shape of a rugby ball

items.name: Mobius Strip
items.fact: A Mobius strip has only one surface and one edge and is impossible to paint both sides

items.name: Helix
items.fact: A helix is a three-dimensional spiral like a coiled spring or DNA strand

items.name: Spiral
items.fact: A spiral is a curve that moves away from a center point getting wider and wider

items.name: Fractal
items.fact: Fractals are shapes that repeat the same pattern at every level of magnification

items.name: Parabola
items.fact: A parabola is a U-shaped curve used in satellite dishes and headlights to focus beams

items.name: Hyperbola
items.fact: A hyperbola is two mirror-image curved branches facing each other

items.name: Catenary
items.fact: A catenary is the natural curve a hanging chain or cable makes under gravity

items.name: Cross
items.fact: A cross shape is formed by two lines or rectangles intersecting at right angles

items.name: Arrow
items.fact: Arrow shapes point in a direction and have been used for navigation since ancient times

items.name: Kite
items.fact: A kite shape has two pairs of adjacent equal sides forming a bird-like diamond

items.name: Chevron
items.fact: A chevron is a V-shaped zigzag pattern used in military ranks and road signs

items.name: Trefoil
items.fact: A trefoil is a three-lobed leaf shape used in architecture and as a symbol of the trinity

items.name: Quatrefoil
items.fact: A quatrefoil has four overlapping circles creating a four-leaf clover pattern

items.name: Vesica Piscis
items.fact: A vesica piscis is formed by two overlapping circles with sacred geometric significance

items.name: Lemniscate
items.fact: A lemniscate is the figure-eight infinity symbol that never ends

items.name: Cardioid
items.fact: A cardioid is a heart-shaped mathematical curve formed by a circle rolling around another

items.name: Reuleaux Triangle
items.fact: A Reuleaux triangle is a curved triangle that rolls smoothly like a circle

items.name: Deltoid
items.fact: A deltoid is a concave kite shape produced when a small circle rolls inside a larger one

items.name: Astroid
items.fact: An astroid is a four-pointed star shape with curved edges traced by a rolling circle

items.name: Lune
items.fact: A lune is a crescent-shaped region bounded by two arcs

items.name: Annulus
items.fact: An annulus is the ring-shaped region between two concentric circles

items.name: Quadrant
items.fact: A quadrant is one quarter of a circle like a pie slice cut at 90 degrees

items.name: Sector
items.fact: A sector is a pie-slice portion of a circle between two radii

items.name: Segment
items.fact: A segment is a region of a circle cut off by a straight chord

items.name: Frustum
items.fact: A frustum is a cone or pyramid with the top cut off creating a flat top surface

items.name: Bipyramid
items.fact: A bipyramid is two pyramids joined at their square bases back to back

items.name: Antiprism
items.fact: An antiprism is like a prism but with one face rotated and triangles connecting the sides

items.name: Prism Hexagonal
items.fact: A hexagonal prism looks like a pencil before it is sharpened

items.name: Stellated Octahedron
items.fact: A stellated octahedron looks like the Star of David in three dimensions

items.name: Klein Bottle
items.fact: A Klein bottle is a one-sided surface with no inside or outside possible only in 4D

items.name: Hypercube
items.fact: A hypercube or tesseract is the four-dimensional equivalent of a cube

items.name: Penrose Triangle
items.fact: The Penrose triangle is an impossible shape that cannot exist in three dimensions

items.name: Golden Spiral
items.fact: The golden spiral grows in proportion to the golden ratio and appears throughout nature

items.name: Fibonacci Spiral
items.fact: The Fibonacci spiral is based on Fibonacci numbers and matches the golden spiral closely

items.name: Apollonius Circle
items.fact: An Apollonius circle is defined by all points that maintain a fixed ratio of distances

items.name: Epicycloid
items.fact: An epicycloid is the path traced by a point on a circle rolling around another circle

items.name: Hypocycloid
items.fact: A hypocycloid is traced by a point on a small circle rolling inside a larger circle

items.name: Trochoid
items.fact: A trochoid is the path traced by a point on a circle rolling along a straight line

items.name: Cycloid
items.fact: A cycloid is the fastest sliding path between two points under gravity ignoring friction

items.name: Archimedean Spiral
items.fact: An Archimedean spiral grows by equal amounts for each turn unlike the golden spiral

items.name: Fermat Spiral
items.fact: A Fermat spiral grows so that each turn encloses equal area making it efficient in nature

items.name: Logarithmic Spiral
items.fact: A logarithmic spiral maintains the same angle to its radius at every point

items.name: Witch of Agnesi
items.fact: The Witch of Agnesi is a bell-shaped curve with a funny name from a translation error

items.name: Sinusoidal Spiral
items.fact: Sinusoidal spirals include shapes from circles to lemniscates depending on a single number

items.name: Rose Curve
items.fact: A rose curve is a beautiful petal-shaped mathematical curve created from a simple equation

items.name: Lissajous Figure
items.fact: Lissajous figures are beautiful looping curves formed by two perpendicular oscillations

items.name: Superellipse
items.fact: A superellipse is the shape between an ellipse and a rectangle used in modern furniture design

items.name: Stadion
items.fact: A stadion is a rectangle with two semicircles on the ends like a running track shape

items.name: Reuleaux Polygon
items.fact: Reuleaux polygons are shapes of constant width based on regular polygons

items.name: Tensegrity
items.fact: Tensegrity structures are made of floating compressed rods held together only by tension

items.name: Polyhedron
items.fact: A polyhedron is any solid 3D shape with flat faces straight edges and sharp vertices

items.name: Zonohedron
items.fact: A zonohedron is a convex polyhedron where every face is a parallelogram

items.name: Stellation
items.fact: A stellation is made by extending a polyhedron's faces until they meet creating star shapes

items.name: Convex Hull
items.fact: The convex hull is the smallest convex shape that contains a set of points like a rubber band stretched around pegs

items.name: Voronoi Cell
items.fact: Voronoi cells divide space based on which seed point is nearest creating organic-looking patterns

items.name: Penrose Tiling
items.fact: Penrose tiles are two shapes that can tile a floor infinitely without ever repeating

items.name: Squircle
items.fact: A squircle is an intermediate shape between a square and a circle used in smartphone icons

items.name: Biangle
items.fact: A biangle or digon has only two sides and two angles and exists on spherical geometry

items.name: Hemicube
items.fact: A hemicube is an abstract polyhedron made by identifying opposite faces of a cube

items.name: Flat Torus
items.fact: A flat torus is a square where opposite edges are considered to be the same edge

items.name: Manifold
items.fact: A manifold is any shape that looks flat and normal when you zoom in very close

items.name: Geodesic Dome
items.fact: A geodesic dome is a spherical structure built from triangles invented by Buckminster Fuller

items.name: Frustum Cone
items.fact: A conical frustum is the shape of a bucket or drinking cup wider at the top

items.name: Torus Knot
items.fact: Torus knots are mathematical knots that wind around a torus surface like a twisted pretzel

items.name: Gyroid
items.fact: A gyroid is a complex saddle-shaped periodic surface with no straight lines at all

items.name: Schwarz Surface
items.fact: Schwarz minimal surfaces are infinitely repeating soap-film-like mathematical surfaces

items.name: Hyperboloid
items.fact: A hyperboloid is a cooling tower shape made entirely from straight lines criss-crossing

items.name: Oloid
items.fact: An oloid is a solid that rolls and wobbles unpredictably contacting its entire surface with the ground

items.name: Spindle Torus
items.fact: A spindle torus is a torus where the tube is so fat it self-intersects at the center

items.name: Horn Torus
items.fact: A horn torus is where the inner circle of a donut shape collapses to a single point
